hooks.command: in=$(cat); case "$in" in *javap*|*unzip*|*"find /"*|*"find ~"*) printf '%s' "$in" | jacli claude hook pre-bash ;; esac; true
in=$(cat); case "$in" in *implements*|*extends*|*interface*|*class*|*record*|*"new "*|*"("*) printf '%s' "$in" | jacli claude hook pre-grep ;; esac; true
d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; for f in pom.xml build.gradle build.gradle.kts settings.gradle settings.gradle.kts; do if [ -e "$d/$f" ]; then jacli claude hook user-prompt; break; fi; done; true
